pages.title: Learn about recent updates
pages.description: This article lists all the updates shipped for SharePoint home sites.
pages.about: This page tracks recent updates and improvements to SharePoint home sites, covering changes to the default app experience (now aligned with SharePoint branding, removing Viva-specific content), the Announcements web part, and home site creation from the admin center.
changes: URL restructured — page relocated from /sharepoint/home-sites-improvements to /sharepoint/homesites/home-sites-improvements
Viva license requirement for Announcements feature explicitly removed
New UX instructions added for returning to default experience via Teams navigation
Default app experience description now specifies removal of 'Go to Connections' UX
